editorial:
Imagine a world where your hobby for finding stories turns into a fight for your life. You get to follow Paige Turner, a girl who is not just a bookworm but also a black belt in martial arts. When weird murders start happening across the city, Paige jumps into the fray with her friends Mo and Sidney. It feels like a wild mix of a detective story and a monster movie, where the stakes get higher every minute. You will see Paige deal with some heavy family secrets regarding her mom while trying to survive things that just won't stay dead.

What really makes this work is the action. The fight scenes are snappy and the twists keep you guessing about who is actually pulling the strings. While some of the special effects look a bit dated, the energy is high and the pacing never slows down. If you love B-movie charm with a lot of punching, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick for a weekend movie night. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out the city officials were experimenting with a virus to create soldiers. Paige discovers her mother was a victim of these tests, which is why she had those secrets. After a huge final fight, Paige and her friends take down the lead scientist and destroy the lab. This stops the spread of the zombies and brings justice to her mother, finally giving Paige the peace she wanted.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves martial arts and zombie flicks.
